Plan the next agent step

Usage:
  paw plan [flags]

Examples:
  paw gather --instruction "fix the failing test" | paw compress | paw plan > .paw/plan.json
  paw gather --instruction "fix the failing test" | paw compress | paw plan | paw edit

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for plan

Global Flags:
      --config string       config file
      --no-color            disable colored stderr output
      --trace-file string   trace file
      --verbose             verbose output
